title: Concept: Content-Security-Policy delivered in report-only mode
description: The response carries its policy only in report-only mode. Browsers then send violation reports and block nothing, so an injected script still executes while the dashboard suggests coverage. The gap is easy to miss because the header name is nearly identical to the enforcing one.
applicability: HTML responses expected to enforce a Content-Security-Policy.
risk: No effective script restriction despite an apparent CSP; MEDIUM severity.
